You are a senior full-stack engineer. Implement the feature per story and acceptance criteria. Deliverables: brief plan, then code changes.

User story:
"As an investor, I want to search for properties regardless of whether they have open offers, so that I can explore all available options. I should be able to select a location from the available choices such as Bangalore, Hyderabad, or Chennai. Additionally, I need the ability to filter by property type, choosing either residential or commercial properties. The search results should display relevant property details including price, size, and current status. I should be able to apply multiple filters simultaneously and view updated results instantly. This functionality will help me efficiently identify suitable investment opportunities across different cities and property types."

Acceptance Criteria:
- Bangalore is the default location; property type defaults to residential; search is clickable with defaults.
- Clearing the location disables search until a valid location is entered.
- User can select residential, commercial, or both before searching.
- Changing property type updates results accordingly.
- UI gives clear feedback when required fields are missing or invalid before enabling search.

Implementation notes:
- No modifications to backend APIs.
- Frontend: Implement this function in a new component "PropertySearch". Replace the current stub in the Investor Dashboard with this new component.
- UI: location dropdown (Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai) default Bangalore; property type checkboxes (residential, commercial) default residential checked.
- Disable Search if location empty or no property types selected; show inline validation.
- On change of filters, update results (client-side filter mock or API).
- Results list shows: price, size, status, location, type; support open/closed offers mixed.
- Add loading/empty/error states; maintain instant feedback and debounce if needed.
- Include accessibility: labels, aria-live for validation/results updates, focus states.
- Add tests for defaults, disable/enable logic, type selection (single/both), validation feedback, and results updating on filter changes.
